name: Scenario gallery cards open the history they describe

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 and scroll to the section 'Six cases the count has to get right' (data-testid=scenario-gallery)
The gallery shows exactly 6 cards (data-testid=scenario-card), and every card shows at least one badge reading 'guarded by TS' followed by a number (data-testid=scenario-guard)
The card titled 'One stay of 107 days: an overstay' shows 107 used, 0 left, '17 days over', and the badge 'guarded by TS27'
On the card titled 'Two long stays: 88 of 90 days used', click 'Open this history' (data-testid=scenario-open)
The page URL contains scenario=near-limit, a demo-scenario banner is shown, and the calculator reads 88 days used and 2 days left
Navigate back to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1, scroll to the gallery and click 'Open this history' on the card titled 'One stay before the EES cutoff, one after'
The browser is on /ees with scenario=cutoff-mixed in the URL, and the EES check shows the scenario banner for 'One stay before the EES cutoff, one after'
